rationale: An entry-level junior estimator and admin role with full training at a partition manufacturer and installer is trade and product estimating, not civil engineering.
Reading architectural and engineering drawings and Microsoft Office are held; estimating is coursework only.
Sunshine West Melbourne is in Marc's home region (Melbourne west).
caution: Below target: partition manufacturing estimating with admin and sales-support duties.
gaps: Admin and sales-support duties are outside civil engineering
